context: Evaluates correct implementation of config-driven metadata rendering with category grouping. Tests that tags are grouped by config.tags[].category, only matching tags are shown, tag.label is used for display (not tag.key), array values are joined, and appropriate fallback messages appear when config or matches are absent.

checklist.name: Tags grouped by category
checklist.description: The rendering logic groups config.tags by their category property, creating one group per unique category value.

checklist.name: Filter to matching keys
checklist.description: Only tags where embedded[tag.key] is truthy (exists in embedded metadata) are included in the grouped output.

checklist.name: Label used for display
checklist.description: Each metadata row displays tag.label from the config as the field name, not the raw tag.key.

checklist.name: Array values joined
checklist.description: Values that are arrays are converted to a display string by joining with ', '.

checklist.name: No config fallback
checklist.description: When config?.tags is falsy, a fallback message indicating configuration unavailability is shown.

checklist.name: No matching tags fallback
checklist.description: When no tags match the embedded metadata (categorizedTags is empty), a fallback message indicating no metadata was found is shown.
